subject: Post-call: Procurement milestones, owners & PO timeline (mutual action plan)
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@brightbridgehealth.com>, BrightBridge Procurement <procure@brightbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: procurement milestones, owners & PO timeline (mutual action plan)

Hi Elena — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our end and proposed mutual action plan so everyone has clarity on owners and dates. Attachment: call-notes-BBH-20271101.txt (meeting notes).

Summary of procurement path we discussed (BrightBridge preference: PO):
- Legal review (internal BBH legal) — expected 1–2 weeks for initial redlines.
- Security review (BrightBridge infosec plus our security packet) — expected 1–3 weeks depending on artifact requests.
- Finance approval & PO issuance — finance lead issues PO after legal and security sign-off; target 1 week for PO after approvals.

High-level timeline (subject to your internal queues):
- Week 0: Redwood sends MPA draft + security packet (we attached the draft MPA and timeline).
- Week 1–2: BBH legal review + first round of redlines.
- Week 2–4: Security questionnaire / evidence exchange.
- Week 4–5: Finance approval and PO creation.

Owners (proposed):
- BrightBridge legal: Elena Morales (primary) / procurement inbox (procure@brightbridgehealth.com)
- BrightBridge security: TBD (Elena — can you confirm name?)
- BrightBridge finance: AP lead (please confirm)
- Redwood: Ava Chen (commercial lead), Ben Carter (contracts), Karthik Iyer (security scoping)

Requested next steps from BrightBridge:
1) Confirm preferred contracting instrument (MPA + PO vs marketplace listing). If PO, confirm whether your standard PO references are required.
2) Share the name and email of the security reviewer so we can send the tailored security packet and schedule a short handoff call.
3) Indicate any internal blackout windows that would affect the timeline.

We can be flexible on signing cadence — if marketplace procurement is faster for you, we can support that route too (we’ll prepare a marketplace checklist). I’m attaching a suggested milestone spreadsheet (procurement-timeline-BBH.xlsx) and a Redwood MPA draft (mpa-redwood-draft-BBH.pdf).

Proposed follow-up: 30-minute check-in next Wednesday (2027-11-03) to review redlines / checklist progress. Let me know whether 9:00–9:30 PT or 11:00–11:30 PT works.

Thanks — Ava

--
Ava Chen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
https://redwood.ai
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@brightbridgehealth.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightBridge Procurement <procure@brightbridgehealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: procurement milestones, owners & PO timeline (mutual action plan)

Hi Ava — great call, thanks for the clear recap. A few quick notes from our side:
- We prefer to go PO + MPA (our procurement team requires the PO to hit the budget line). Marketplace is acceptable if it shortens legal lead time, but finance prefers PO.
- Security reviewer is Priya Menon (pri.menon@brightbridgehealth.com) — I copied the procurement inbox above; I’ll introduce Priya to the Redwood security lead later today.
- AP lead is Jason Ortiz (jason.ortiz@brightbridgehealth.com) — he will generate the PO once legal signs off.

We will do an initial legal pass internally this week. I’m returning the call-notes file with inline comments (attachment: call-notes-BBH-20271101.txt). Also attaching our standard procurement questionnaire — Priya asked we fill gaps directly in the packet; I’ll upload the questionnaire to our shared drive and share a link in the next email.

Proposed timing: we should be able to complete legal initial review by 2027-11-08, security review by 2027-11-15, and target PO issuance by 2027-11-17 assuming no major redlines. I’ll confirm if any internal holidays shift this.

Can you confirm who from Redwood will own the security packet and be the point-of-contact for Priya?

Thanks, Elena

--
Elena Morales
Head of Strategic Procurement | BrightBridge Health
elena.morales@brightbridgehealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0998
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 09:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Owners + draft timeline for BBH (to share with Elena)

Ava / Karthik / Marissa — quick internal note so we’re aligned before the check-in with BrightBridge:
- I’ll take primary on contract negotiations and shepherd the MPA redlines. My goal: return an agreed redline set within 2 business days of receiving BBH’s first pass.
- Karthik — can you confirm you’ll own the security packet handoff to Priya Menon and be available for a 30-min sync this week? If you want, I can include our security checklist as part of the initial packet.
- Marissa — can you confirm the DocuSign template we should surface for MPA + SOW? If finance insists on PO, we’ll ensure we add reference fields in the MPA (PO number).

Proposed internal timeline (Redwood-owned activities):
- Tues 11/02: Ben prepares redline playbook + initial MPA markup template.
- Wed 11/03: Security packet + evidence bundle shipped to Priya; Karthik to host a 20-min walk-through.
- Fri 11/05: Redwood returns revised MPA (incorporating commercial concessions discussed).
- Mon 11/08: Expect BrightBridge first-pass from legal (per Elena). Ben to triage and propose countered items.

Risk flags: if BrightBridge security requests a penetration test that we don’t have on file, turnaround may slip 1–2 weeks. Also, if finance requires a PO only after a signed SOW vs PO referencing MPA, that could add 3–5 business days to issuance.

I’ll prepare procurement-timeline-BBH.xlsx with dates adjusted to Elena’s proposed milestones and share in the check-in.

Thanks,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Principal Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@brightbridgehealth.com>, BrightBridge Procurement <procure@brightbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Nov 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: procurement milestones, owners & PO timeline (mutual action plan) — confirmed next steps

Elena / team — thanks for the confirmations and for introducing Priya. Finalized mutual action plan below (I converted dates to calendar targets per your note). Please treat this as the single source of truth — I’ll update the HubSpot deal and attach the final timeline. Links below.

Mutual action plan (owners & target dates):
1) Redwood: deliver MPA draft + security packet + procurement-timeline-BBH.xlsx — owner: Ben Carter — ETA: today (11/03) end of day. Attachment: mpa-redwood-draft-BBH.pdf (sent), procurement-timeline-BBH.xlsx (sent).
2) BrightBridge: legal first-pass — owner: Elena Morales — ETA: 2027-11-08.
3) BrightBridge: security review & evidence requests — owner: Priya Menon — ETA: 2027-11-15. Redwood to assign security owner Karthik Iyer and send evidence bundle same day.
4) BrightBridge: finance / AP issues PO referencing MPA — owner: Jason Ortiz — ETA: 2027-11-17 (target).
5) Sign & enable: Redwood to accept PO and finalize DocuSign (Marissa to orchestrate) — target 2027-11-18.

Meeting cadence:
- 30-min check-in: 2027-11-03 11:00 PT (check-in to confirm MPA delivery + security handoff).
- Weekly 15-min standing during the queue (optional) until PO is issued.

Action items (immediate):
- Elena: confirm if BBH legal wants any standard clause templates included in our initial MPA (e.g., indemnity thresholds).
- Priya: accept calendar invite from Karthik for security packet walk-through.
- Ben: upload finished procurement-timeline-BBH.xlsx to the HubSpot deal and share DocuSign packet link.
- Marissa: prepare DocuSign template with PO reference field and share with Jason (BBH AP).

If anything changes on your end (timing or owners), reply here and I’ll adjust the timeline. HubSpot link: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/BBH-2027-089. DocuSign packet: https://docusign.com/packet/BBH-MPA-2027

Best — Ava
